 DAYTON, Ohio (WKEF) -- With Medicare open enrollment nearing its end, beneficiaries have only until Dec. 7 to review their coverage and make any changes for the year ahead.
 Even for those satisfied with their current plan, experts say it is important to confirm that doctors, prescriptions, and out-of-pocket costs still match their needs. The wide range of available options can make the decision feel overwhelming.
 To help explain what consumers should know before the deadline, Dr. Manoj Pawar, Chief Medical Officer and Vice President at Mutual of Omaha, and Jeff Ganow, Senior Vice President of Senior Health Solutions at Mutual of Omaha, joined Lydia Bice via Zoom.
